entities.summary: Ramin Muzaffar oghlu Hasanov is an Azerbaijani diplomat, who is the current Ambassador Extraordinary and Plenipotentiary of the Republic of Azerbaijan to the Republic of Korea. Before, he was the Ambassador Extraordinary and Plenipotentiary of the Republic of Azerbaijan to the Federal Republic of Germany.
